chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abd al-Rahman from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) performed eight [circuits], adding six, then he bowed in four rak'at." Because if the matter is as we described, then he prays the two rak'at upon completion of the two tawafs and proceeds to the sa'i. When he completes the sa'i, he returns and prays two other rak'at, and he has acted upon both reports together. And that which indicates what we mentioned is what he narrated:

key_terms.السَّعْيِ: the sa'i (walking between Safa and Marwa)

ai.seo_question: How did Ali (peace be upon him) perform the prayers associated with the tawaf and sa'i during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) specific practice of performing eight circuits (adding six to the standard two) and praying four rak'at, serving as a key evidence for reconciling differing juristic opinions on post-Tawaf prayers. It illustrates the Shia scholarly method of harmonizing conflicting reports by adopting a comprehensive approach—praying after both Tawaf and Sa'i—to ensure ritual completeness. This practice underscores the importance of following the Imams' detailed guidance in distinguishing between obligatory acts and recommended supererogatory prayers during Hajj.
